name: Synthetic storm (contract fixture: every number invented)
notes: est, lo and hi are the estimated fraction of customers without power and its 80% range, from Black Marble night lights. They are null where the satellite can't see the county or it is too dark to measure: unknown, never zero.
official is EAGLE-I's customers out at the satellite pass (median of the runs within ±60 minutes, feed-dropout runs removed) over the county's customer count.

Policies and claims are synthetic: 100,000 policies placed by Census housing units (5% business, seed 20261105) and 200 claims, about 10% of them deliberately inflated past the county's official restoration day.

official is cleaned by model.apply_overcount_rule: 1 county-night(s) it treats as EAGLE-I over-counts (more customers out than the county has) are shown as null, and 1 slightly above 100% are shown as 100%.
1 visible county-night(s) have no estimate from the fit; they show as unknown.
EAGLE-I covers too few customers in ZB (70%) for the curve to train on, so official numbers there undercount.
1 county(ies) have no EAGLE-I customer count (MCC.csv), so official is null there.
